headline: Hela of Mice and Magic December 1
title: Hela Of Mice and Magic Release Date December 1 | Play as a Brave Mouse | Gaming News
video_script: Hela of Mice and Magic is a Scandinavian folklore adventure where you play as a brave mouse. It launches on December first on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC. You explore a three D open world, solve puzzles, and help the land through heartwarming stories. Would you play as a mouse? Comment below!
description: Hela: of Mice & Magic launches December 1, 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store). Publisher Knights Peak, developer Windup Games. Sources: Gematsu, Steam store page.
